learning_outcomes.text: Understands heat transfer in boiling and condensation processes, analyzes heat exchangers and knows mass transfer mechanisms.
Knows two-phase heat transfer systems and methods used in the design of heat exchangers.
Have a good command of heat convection and mass transfer analogies.
Knows the methods used in the design of mass transfer mechanisms.

syllabus_topics: BOILING HEAT TRANSFER: Pool boiling, boiling regimes and the boiling curve, heat transfer correlations in pool boiling.
CONDENSATION HEAT TRANSFER: Film condensation, flow regimes, heat transfer correlations for film condensation.
TWO PHASE FLOW: Quality and void fraction in a nonflow system, the flow system, critical flow, two phase critical flow.
HEAT EXCHANGERS: Types of heat exchangers, the overall heat transfer coefficient, fouling factor. Analysis of heat exchangers.
HEAT EXCHANGERS: Multipass and cross flow heat exchangers. Effectiveness-NTU method, selection of heat exchangers, compact heat exchangers.
HEAT EXCHANGERS: Boilers, evaporators and condensers for refrigeration and air-conditioning systems.
MASS TRANSFER: Analogy between heat and mass transfer.
IDEAL GAS MIXTURES: Fick's law of diffusion, mass diffusion.
MASS DIFFUSION: The mass diffusion equation, boundary and initial conditions, steady mass diffusion through a wall.
MASS DIFFUSION: Water vapor migration in buildings, transient mass diffusion, diffusion in a moving medium.
MASS DIFFUSION: Diffusion of vapor through a stationary gas; Stefan flow, equimolar counter diffusion.
MASS DIFFUSION: Transient mass diffusion in a moving medium, gas mixtures at constant pressure and temperature.
MASS CONVECTION: Limitations on the heat-mass convection analogy.
MASS CONVECTION: Limitations on the heat-mass convection analogy.
